text:
Type: wall-mounted storage cabinet
Use: storing and displaying small items; living room, home office, entryway
Style: farmhouse, rustic
Materials: distressed natural wood planks, black metal handles
Colors: warm medium brown wood, black
Shape: shallow wall box, three open cubbies on top, two barn doors with X-brace planks below, arched black pulls, compact and flat
Feel: cozy, rustic, homely
Goes with: white or cream walls, black iron accents, reclaimed wood; farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Farmhouse Wall Mounted Cabinet Storage Organzier - 23 x19 x 6 Inch, Natural Wood (Renewed)
product.description: This wall cabinet provides vintage style along with storage space for spices, mail and more in your kitchen or entryway. Display small objects or stash your keys in the three cubbies on the bottom. The distressed finish adds to the antique appeal. 19.25" W x 23.25" H x 6.75" D Constructed from hardwood; iron hinges and door pulls Ready to hang, all hardware included
